1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.StarInverseDisks
2 
3 /-! The assembled cofacial-source development is globally injective
4 and identifies the retained surface with an open subset of the plane. -/
5 
6 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph
7 
8 open Set Filter Topology
9 
10 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (graph : P.SixVertexGraph)
11   (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
12     (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
13 
14 include graph small_faces
15 
16 /-- No two retained surface points are identified anywhere in the development. -/
17 theorem develop_injective {a : frontier P.body} {T : P.CutLocusTree a} (charts : CutTreeCharts T)
18     (source : Fin 6) (at_source : (a : Space) = (graph.vertex source : Space))
19     (cofacial : ∀ v : P.Vertex, ∃ F : P.Face, (a : Space) ∈ F.val ∧ (v : Space) ∈ F.val) :
20     Function.Injective (fun b : P.UncutSurface a => charts.develop b.val) := by
21   intro b c same
22   change charts.develop b.val = charts.develop c.val at same
23   obtain ⟨radius, positive, inverse, _, _, left_inverse⟩ :=
24     graph.every_retained_point_has_inverse_disk small_faces charts source at_source cofacial b
25   have b_in : charts.develop b.val ∈ Metric.ball (charts.develop b.val) radius := Metric.mem_ball_self positive
26   have c_in : charts.develop c.val ∈ Metric.ball (charts.develop b.val) radius := by rw [← same]; exact b_in
27   calc
28     b = inverse ⟨charts.develop b.val, b_in⟩ := (left_inverse b b_in).symm
29     _ = inverse ⟨charts.develop c.val, c_in⟩ := congrArg inverse (Subtype.ext same)
30     _ = c := left_inverse c c_in
31 
32 /-- Open retained surface regions develop to open planar regions. -/
33 theorem develop_isOpenMap {a : frontier P.body} {T : P.CutLocusTree a} (charts : CutTreeCharts T)
34     (source : Fin 6) (at_source : (a : Space) = (graph.vertex source : Space))
35     (cofacial : ∀ v : P.Vertex, ∃ F : P.Face, (a : Space) ∈ F.val ∧ (v : Space) ∈ F.val) :
36     IsOpenMap (fun b : P.UncutSurface a => charts.develop b.val) := by
37   intro S openS
38   apply isOpen_iff_mem_nhds.mpr
39   rintro y ⟨b, b_in, rfl⟩
40   obtain ⟨radius, positive, inverse, _, right_inverse, left_inverse⟩ :=
41     graph.every_retained_point_has_inverse_disk small_faces charts source at_source cofacial b
42   let region : Set Plane := Subtype.val '' (inverse ⁻¹' S)
43   have open_region : IsOpen region := Metric.isOpen_ball.isOpenMap_subtype_val _
44     (openS.preimage inverse.continuous)
45   have center_in : charts.develop b.val ∈ region := by
46     refine ⟨⟨charts.develop b.val, Metric.mem_ball_self positive⟩, ?_, rfl⟩
47     change inverse ⟨charts.develop b.val, Metric.mem_ball_self positive⟩ ∈ S
48     rw [left_inverse]
49     exact b_in
50   have covered : region ⊆ (fun c : P.UncutSurface a => charts.develop c.val) '' S := by
51     rintro x ⟨z, member, rfl⟩
52     exact ⟨inverse z, member, right_inverse z⟩
53   exact mem_of_superset (open_region.mem_nhds center_in) covered
54 
55 /-- The constructed development is an open embedding of the entire retained surface. -/
56 theorem develop_isOpenEmbedding {a : frontier P.body} {T : P.CutLocusTree a} (charts : CutTreeCharts T)
57     (source : Fin 6) (at_source : (a : Space) = (graph.vertex source : Space))
58     (cofacial : ∀ v : P.Vertex, ∃ F : P.Face, (a : Space) ∈ F.val ∧ (v : Space) ∈ F.val) :
59     Topology.IsOpenEmbedding (fun b : P.UncutSurface a => charts.develop b.val) :=
60   .of_continuous_injective_isOpenMap (graph.develop_continuous small_faces charts cofacial)
61     (graph.develop_injective small_faces charts source at_source cofacial)
62     (graph.develop_isOpenMap small_faces charts source at_source cofacial)
63 
64 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph
